// Isolated absent-error interface obligation. Option is a candidate Rust
// representation of the original nil input, not an implemented production API.
// Do not manufacture the fallback diagnostic in the observer.
mod runtime;
#[path = "process_unix.rs"] mod process;
#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> std::process::ExitCode {
    let runtime = runtime::Runtime::new().unwrap();
    let result = Err(runtime.fail(None));
    std::process::ExitCode::from(runtime.finish(result).await)
}
